units.id: mission:Theater Chat|As you are walking through the spaceport, you come across the uncommon pairing of a Hai and a human, their conversation standing out by virtue of speaking the common tongue of humanity.|26|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, you come across the uncommon pairing of a Hai and a human, their conversation standing out by virtue of speaking the common tongue of humanity.
units.italian: Mentre attraversate lo spazioporto, vi imbattete nell'insolita coppia di un Hai e un umano, la cui conversazione spicca perché parlano la lingua comune dell'umanità.

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	"Oh, oh, Gemanari, this looks interesting!" The human woman looks to be in her late sixties and, when you turn to look, seems to be clucking over a holographic advertisement for a theater show. "This looks adorable, doesn't it? Oh, and it says they're using ripple ray refractive holographic flight effects!"|27|0
units.english: "Oh, oh, Gemanari, this looks interesting!" The human woman looks to be in her late sixties and, when you turn to look, seems to be clucking over a holographic advertisement for a theater show. "This looks adorable, doesn't it? Oh, and it says they're using ripple ray refractive holographic flight effects!"
units.italian: "Oh, oh, Gemanari, questo sembra interessante!" La donna umana dimostra una sessantina d'anni avanzata e, quando vi voltate a guardare, sembra intenerirsi davanti a un annuncio olografico di uno spettacolo teatrale. "È adorabile, non trovi? Oh, e dice che usano effetti di volo olografici a rifrazione con raggi ondulati!"

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	The advertisement does indeed look very impressive, and you pause to observe for a moment.|28|0
units.english: The advertisement does indeed look very impressive, and you pause to observe for a moment.
units.italian: L'annuncio in effetti è molto impressionante, e vi fermate a osservarlo per un momento.

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	The Hai, presumably Gemanari, also appears to be a more mature lady who squints at it and wrinkles her nose. "Ugh, that's the Germontian interpretation though."|29|0
units.english: The Hai, presumably Gemanari, also appears to be a more mature lady who squints at it and wrinkles her nose. "Ugh, that's the Germontian interpretation though."
units.italian: L'Hai, presumibilmente Gemanari, sembra anche lei una signora di una certa età: socchiude gli occhi e arriccia il naso. "Ugh, però è l'interpretazione germontiana."

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	This receives a puzzled look to which Gemanari thinks for a second before clarifying. "You would say the Social Darwinist interpretation."|30|0
units.english: This receives a puzzled look to which Gemanari thinks for a second before clarifying. "You would say the Social Darwinist interpretation."
units.italian: La cosa suscita uno sguardo perplesso, e Gemanari riflette un secondo prima di chiarire. "Vorreste dire l'interpretazione darwinista sociale."

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	The lady grimaces and makes like she's vomiting. "I can't believe you still have those schools of thought in a society this old."|31|0
units.english: The lady grimaces and makes like she's vomiting. "I can't believe you still have those schools of thought in a society this old."
units.italian: La signora fa una smorfia e simula di vomitare. "Non posso credere che abbiate ancora queste correnti di pensiero, in una società così antica."

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	"Oh we don't really, at least not in scientific circles, but a compelling story will outlive such things. I can't stand it personally, but it is a classic." When the lady looks unimpressed, Gemanari titters and takes her gently by the arm to steer her away again. "Don't worry Alinta; I think the Misheep Wah'uden company is running my preferred interpretation on <destination> at the moment. We can see if they have any cheap tickets. Of course my aunt would insist that the hundred and eighty-third version is the only real one, but she always..."|32|0
units.english: "Oh we don't really, at least not in scientific circles, but a compelling story will outlive such things. I can't stand it personally, but it is a classic." When the lady looks unimpressed, Gemanari titters and takes her gently by the arm to steer her away again. "Don't worry Alinta; I think the Misheep Wah'uden company is running my preferred interpretation on <destination> at the moment. We can see if they have any cheap tickets. Of course my aunt would insist that the hundred and eighty-third version is the only real one, but she always..."
units.italian: "Oh, in realtà no, almeno non nei circoli scientifici, ma una storia avvincente sopravvive a queste cose. Personalmente non la sopporto, ma è un classico." Siccome la signora non sembra impressionata, Gemanari ridacchia e la prende delicatamente per un braccio per portarla via. "Non preoccuparti, Alinta; credo che la compagnia Misheep Wah'uden stia mettendo in scena la mia interpretazione preferita su <destination>, in questo momento. Possiamo vedere se hanno biglietti a buon mercato. Certo, mia zia insisterebbe che la centottantatreesima versione è l'unica vera, ma lei..."

units.id: mission:Theater Chat|	You lose the conversation as they trail away from you, leaving you to wonder just what was so special about the hundred and eighty-third version of a play about a prehistoric flying Hai found frozen in the ice.|33|0
units.english: You lose the conversation as they trail away from you, leaving you to wonder just what was so special about the hundred and eighty-third version of a play about a prehistoric flying Hai found frozen in the ice.
units.italian: Perdete la conversazione mentre si allontanano, e restate a chiedervi cosa avesse di così speciale la centottantatreesima versione di un'opera su un Hai preistorico alato trovato congelato nel ghiaccio.

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|While stopped in the spaceport waiting for refueling, you are surprised by how hard it is to find somewhere to sit and have a meal and a drink. It seems Hai have crammed themselves into every bar or similar venue with a public display screen, arrayed in sashes and mantles and all manner of other paraphernalia which, near as you can tell, look like... team sport merchandise?|47|0
units.english: While stopped in the spaceport waiting for refueling, you are surprised by how hard it is to find somewhere to sit and have a meal and a drink. It seems Hai have crammed themselves into every bar or similar venue with a public display screen, arrayed in sashes and mantles and all manner of other paraphernalia which, near as you can tell, look like... team sport merchandise?
units.italian: Mentre siete fermi nello spazioporto in attesa del rifornimento, vi sorprende quanto sia difficile trovare un posto dove sedervi a mangiare e bere. Gli Hai si sono stipati in ogni bar o locale simile dotato di uno schermo pubblico, sfoggiando fasce, mantelli e ogni sorta di altro accessorio che, per quanto riuscite a capire, somiglia a... merchandising di squadre sportive?

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	You're not really an expert on what such things look like in Hai society and so when you finally find somewhere to sit, at a bar for lack of any other options, you ask the tired-looking bartender what exactly is going on.|48|0
units.english: You're not really an expert on what such things look like in Hai society and so when you finally find somewhere to sit, at a bar for lack of any other options, you ask the tired-looking bartender what exactly is going on.
units.italian: Non siete esperti di come si presentino queste cose nella società Hai, e così, quando alla fine trovate un posto dove sedervi, in un bar per mancanza di alternative, chiedete al cameriere dall'aria stanca che cosa stia esattamente succedendo.

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Oh this? They're all here for the Musical Entertainment Expo streams. Unfortunately, none of them start drinking until at least one of their teams has announced something of worth," he says with an exasperated eye-roll.|49|0
units.english: "Oh this? They're all here for the Musical Entertainment Expo streams. Unfortunately, none of them start drinking until at least one of their teams has announced something of worth," he says with an exasperated eye-roll.
units.italian: "Ah, questo? Sono tutti qui per le dirette della Musical Entertainment Expo. Purtroppo nessuno di loro inizia a bere prima che almeno una delle loro squadre abbia annunciato qualcosa che valga la pena," dice, roteando gli occhi con esasperazione.

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Okay. Can I just get some food here?"|51|0
units.english: "Okay. Can I just get some food here?"
units.italian: "Ok. Posso solo avere qualcosa da mangiare?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"What's the Musical Entertainment Expo?"|53|0
units.english: "What's the Musical Entertainment Expo?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è la Musical Entertainment Expo?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Why don't they start drinking yet?"|54|0
units.english: "Why don't they start drinking yet?"
units.italian: "Perché non hanno ancora iniziato a bere?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Well you see, the big music labels do a lot of talent scouting all year round. They all have departments solely dedicated to finding and assembling new music groups to be the next big thing. It's tradition to celebrate only after you've committed to the journey with a new band. Every three years the industry holds ME2, which is what you're seeing up there, to debut their next round of bands and to tease any mid-season releases they might have in the works."|55|0
units.english: "Well you see, the big music labels do a lot of talent scouting all year round. They all have departments solely dedicated to finding and assembling new music groups to be the next big thing. It's tradition to celebrate only after you've committed to the journey with a new band. Every three years the industry holds ME2, which is what you're seeing up there, to debut their next round of bands and to tease any mid-season releases they might have in the works."
units.italian: "Beh, vede, le grandi etichette discografiche fanno molta ricerca di talenti tutto l'anno. Hanno reparti dedicati esclusivamente a trovare e mettere insieme nuovi gruppi destinati a diventare il prossimo fenomeno. È tradizione festeggiare solo dopo essersi impegnati nel viaggio con una nuova band. Ogni tre anni l'industria organizza ME2, quello che sta vedendo lassù, per presentare il nuovo giro di band e per stuzzicare eventuali uscite di metà stagione che hanno in cantiere."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Your music comes off a production line?"|57|0
units.english: "Your music comes off a production line?"
units.italian: "La vostra musica esce da una catena di montaggio?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Do you not have musicians trying to make it on their own?"|59|0
units.english: "Do you not have musicians trying to make it on their own?"
units.italian: "Non avete musicisti che cercano di sfondare da soli?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Oh for sure, but mostly just to get picked up by one of these companies."|60|0
units.english: "Oh for sure, but mostly just to get picked up by one of these companies."
units.italian: "Oh, certo, ma soprattutto per farsi prendere da una di queste aziende."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	The bartender chuckles. "We've been doing pop music for longer than your people have had fire. It's about the experience of being a fan of a group as it rises to fame and stardom. A dedicated Hai can go back and find a song for almost any possible life experience in almost any possible genre. It's the journey, and the personalities, that are what it's all about."|62|0
units.english: The bartender chuckles. "We've been doing pop music for longer than your people have had fire. It's about the experience of being a fan of a group as it rises to fame and stardom. A dedicated Hai can go back and find a song for almost any possible life experience in almost any possible genre. It's the journey, and the personalities, that are what it's all about."
units.italian: Il cameriere ridacchia. "Facciamo pop music da più tempo di quanto la vostra gente abbia conosciuto il fuoco. Si tratta dell'esperienza di essere fan di un gruppo mentre sale alla fama e al successo. Un Hai appassionato può andare a cercare una canzone per quasi ogni possibile esperienza di vita, in quasi ogni possibile genere. È il viaggio, e le personalità, quel che conta."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"How strange."|64|0
units.english: "How strange."
units.italian: "Che strano."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"How interesting."|65|0
units.english: "How interesting."
units.italian: "Che interessante."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	"Anyway, I gather you were after some food?"|66|0
units.english: "Anyway, I gather you were after some food?"
units.italian: "Comunque, mi pareva voleste qualcosa da mangiare?"

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	The bartender tips his head in your direction and takes your order. "No problem, it'll be right up."|68|0
units.english: The bartender tips his head in your direction and takes your order. "No problem, it'll be right up."
units.italian: Il cameriere accenna un cenno verso di voi e prende l'ordine. "Nessun problema, arriva subito."

units.id: mission:Musical Entertainment Expo|	It's a noisy meal.|69|0
units.english: It's a noisy meal.
units.italian: È un pasto rumoroso.

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|Stepping into the spaceport you are beset by a riot of color. Every blank surface that's not usually paid advertising space seems to be festooned with dangling holographic projectors, banners, and ribbons. There's even actual paper fliers and posters, apparently taped to whatever surface will bear them. At first you wonder if there's some sort of festival going on, but as you watch a young Hai wearing a hood slaps up another holo projector, creating a cartoonish root vegetable with a sword, which begins hacking at the adjacent hologram, some kind of impressionist concept of a Hai elder made up of iridescent triangles. The young Hai then proceeds to tear down a banner and slap some goo on a massive poster which begins dissolving before a pair of security guards, wearing some very obviously non-standard additions to their uniforms, chase him back out of the spaceport.|83|0
units.english: Stepping into the spaceport you are beset by a riot of color. Every blank surface that's not usually paid advertising space seems to be festooned with dangling holographic projectors, banners, and ribbons. There's even actual paper fliers and posters, apparently taped to whatever surface will bear them. At first you wonder if there's some sort of festival going on, but as you watch a young Hai wearing a hood slaps up another holo projector, creating a cartoonish root vegetable with a sword, which begins hacking at the adjacent hologram, some kind of impressionist concept of a Hai elder made up of iridescent triangles. The young Hai then proceeds to tear down a banner and slap some goo on a massive poster which begins dissolving before a pair of security guards, wearing some very obviously non-standard additions to their uniforms, chase him back out of the spaceport.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto, venite investiti da un tripudio di colori. Ogni superficie vuota che di solito non è spazio pubblicitario a pagamento sembra addobbata con proiettori olografici pendenti, striscioni e nastri. Ci sono persino volantini e manifesti veri, di carta, apparentemente attaccati con nastro adesivo a qualunque superficie li regga. All'inizio vi chiedete se ci sia una specie di festa, ma poi vedete un giovane Hai incappucciato che appiccica un altro proiettore olografico, creando un ortaggio a radice in stile cartone animato con una spada, che comincia a fare a pezzi l'ologramma accanto, una specie di concetto impressionista di un anziano Hai fatto di triangoli iridescenti. Il giovane Hai poi strappa giù uno striscione e spalma una specie di poltiglia su un manifesto enorme, che inizia a sciogliersi mentre due guardie di sicurezza, con aggiunte molto evidentemente non regolamentari alle uniformi, lo inseguono fuori dallo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	As you watch, the triangular elder being holoprojected seems to flicker and then fizzles out as the battery unit fades, apparently under the assault of the root vegetable which appears to do a victory dance, before proceeding to act out something that makes precisely no sense to you.|86|0
units.english: As you watch, the triangular elder being holoprojected seems to flicker and then fizzles out as the battery unit fades, apparently under the assault of the root vegetable which appears to do a victory dance, before proceeding to act out something that makes precisely no sense to you.
units.italian: Mentre guardate, l'anziano triangolare proiettato in ologramma sembra tremolare e poi si spegne mentre la batteria si esaurisce, apparentemente sotto l'assalto dell'ortaggio a radice, che accenna una danza di vittoria e poi mette in scena qualcosa che per voi non ha assolutamente senso.

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	A little further on you encounter two different groups of protesters, assuming that's what they are, weaving in and out of the spaceport's entrances like some kind of conga line. The triangular elder and opposing root vegetable make several reappearances on their placards, some of them holographically animated.|87|0
units.english: A little further on you encounter two different groups of protesters, assuming that's what they are, weaving in and out of the spaceport's entrances like some kind of conga line. The triangular elder and opposing root vegetable make several reappearances on their placards, some of them holographically animated.
units.italian: Poco più avanti incontrate due diversi gruppi di manifestanti, ammesso che siano questo, che si intrecciano dentro e fuori dagli ingressi dello spazioporto come in una specie di conga. L'anziano triangolare e l'ortaggio a radice avversario ricompaiono più volte sui loro cartelli, alcuni animati in ologramma.

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	A different security guard, this one in regular attire, appears at your elbow. "You look a little lost. Don't worry, it's just a meme war. Carry on with your business and don't touch the meme items and no one should bother you over it."|88|0
units.english: A different security guard, this one in regular attire, appears at your elbow. "You look a little lost. Don't worry, it's just a meme war. Carry on with your business and don't touch the meme items and no one should bother you over it."
units.italian: Un'altra guardia di sicurezza, questa in uniforme regolare, vi compare al gomito. "Sembra un po' perso. Non si preoccupi, è solo una guerra di meme. Faccia i suoi affari e non tocchi gli oggetti dei meme e nessuno dovrebbe darle fastidio per questo."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	You thank the security guard for his advice and go about what you were doing as the baffling conflict continues around you.|89|0
units.english: You thank the security guard for his advice and go about what you were doing as the baffling conflict continues around you.
units.italian: Ringraziate la guardia per il consiglio e proseguite con quello che stavate facendo mentre l'incomprensibile conflitto continua intorno a voi.

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	As you watch, the triangular elder being holoprojected seems to flicker and then fizzles out as the battery unit fades, apparently under the assault of the root vegetable which appears to do a victory dance. To your surprise, your translator pipes up: "[Victory, Success] for the true and square root that is more [significant, meaningful] than the tripartite [system, tradition] of the elders!"|92|0
units.english: As you watch, the triangular elder being holoprojected seems to flicker and then fizzles out as the battery unit fades, apparently under the assault of the root vegetable which appears to do a victory dance. To your surprise, your translator pipes up: "[Victory, Success] for the true and square root that is more [significant, meaningful] than the tripartite [system, tradition] of the elders!"
units.italian: Mentre guardate, l'anziano triangolare proiettato in ologramma sembra tremolare e poi si spegne mentre la batteria si esaurisce, apparentemente sotto l'assalto dell'ortaggio a radice, che accenna una danza di vittoria. Con vostra sorpresa, il vostro traduttore si fa sentire: "[Vittoria, Successo] per la radice vera e quadrata, che è più [significativa, importante] del [sistema, tradizione] tripartito degli anziani!"

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	A little further on you encounter two different groups of protesters, assuming that's what they are, weaving in and out of the spaceport's entrances like some kind of conga line. The triangular elder and opposing root vegetable make several reappearances on their placards, some of them holographically animated.|93|0
units.english: A little further on you encounter two different groups of protesters, assuming that's what they are, weaving in and out of the spaceport's entrances like some kind of conga line. The triangular elder and opposing root vegetable make several reappearances on their placards, some of them holographically animated.
units.italian: Poco più avanti incontrate due diversi gruppi di manifestanti, ammesso che siano questo, che si intrecciano dentro e fuori dagli ingressi dello spazioporto come in una specie di conga. L'anziano triangolare e l'ortaggio a radice avversario ricompaiono più volte sui loro cartelli, alcuni animati in ologramma.

units.english: A different security guard, this one in regular attire, appears at your elbow. "You look a little lost. Don't worry, it's just a meme war. Carry on with your business and don't touch the meme items, and no one should bother you over it."
units.italian: Un'altra guardia di sicurezza, questa in uniforme regolare, vi compare al gomito. "Sembra un po' perso. Non si preoccupi, è solo una guerra di meme. Faccia i suoi affari e non tocchi gli oggetti dei meme, e nessuno dovrebbe darle fastidio per questo."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	"Sure, will do."|96|0
units.english: "Sure, will do."
units.italian: "Certo, lo farò."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	"Your elders have a tripartite system?"|98|0
units.english: "Your elders have a tripartite system?"
units.italian: "I vostri anziani hanno un sistema tripartito?"

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	The security guard chuckles and says, "Oh you can understand? They don't really, but it's a very old joke from a bygone political campaign that there are only three tenets the elders care about, and they're all the ones that affect us the least."|99|0
units.english: The security guard chuckles and says, "Oh you can understand? They don't really, but it's a very old joke from a bygone political campaign that there are only three tenets the elders care about, and they're all the ones that affect us the least."
units.italian: La guardia ridacchia e dice: "Oh, lei capisce? In realtà no, ma è una vecchia battuta di una campagna politica ormai passata, secondo cui gli anziani tengono solo a tre principi, e sono tutti quelli che ci toccano meno."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	When you ask what has triggered this, he says, "Oh, the latest education priorities came out with a four tenet focus, on the same day that an elder accidentally quoted the old campaign. It has been very entertaining."|100|0
units.english: When you ask what has triggered this, he says, "Oh, the latest education priorities came out with a four tenet focus, on the same day that an elder accidentally quoted the old campaign. It has been very entertaining."
units.italian: Quando chiedete cosa abbia scatenato tutto questo, dice: "Oh, le ultime priorità educative sono uscite con un'impostazione su quattro principi, lo stesso giorno in cui un anziano ha citato per sbaglio la vecchia campagna. È stato molto divertente."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	"How strange."|102|0
units.english: "How strange."
units.italian: "Che strano."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	"Sounds fun."|103|0
units.english: "Sounds fun."
units.italian: "Sembra divertente."

units.id: mission:The Meme Wars 1|	You thank the security guard for his advice and go about what you were doing as the baffling conflict continues around you.|105|0
units.english: You thank the security guard for his advice and go about what you were doing as the baffling conflict continues around you.
units.italian: Ringraziate la guardia per il consiglio e proseguite con quello che stavate facendo mentre l'incomprensibile conflitto continua intorno a voi.
